title: Extract visual motif module API
summary: Create a reusable visual motif module/API for vanish, collapse/reveal, artifact replace, wrap/unwrap, layout shift, focus, compare, trace, and highlight-flow so the equation demo controller stops owning semantic-free timing logic.

sourceRefs.summary: Current equation motion plan types and visual motif phase vocabulary.
Samples visual motif phases into renderer-consumable equation frames.
Existing motif timeline helpers that should inform the extracted shared API.
Controller-local motif routing that should become thinner after extraction.
Plan-level regression tests for motif phases and semantic beats.
Frame-sampling regression tests for motif timing.

expectedLearning: Where the boundary belongs between semantic transformations, reusable visual motifs, sampled frames, and controller-only DOM concerns.
Which current equation animation behaviors can be expressed as shared motif parameters without losing visual fidelity.
allowedWork: Extract shared visual motif types, phase helpers, timing descriptors, and adapters from the equation motion plan/sampler/controller path.
Retain existing animation behavior while making the motif vocabulary reusable by KaTeX, graph, and future programming views.
Add focused tests that prove current cancel, simplify, wrap, radical, and layout-shift motifs still sample correctly.
disallowedWork: Do not add new visual effects beyond the extracted API surface.
Do not redesign the dashboard or animation card while extracting the motif module.
Do not rewrite graph renderers or the semantic object model in this slice.
